items.description: The API boundary module (app/routes/) contains no import of the ORM session or any SQLAlchemy session object
The stock service module (app/services/) contains no import of the ORM session or any SQLAlchemy session object
The application reads DATABASE_URL exclusively from the process environment and raises an error if it is absent rather than falling back to a hardcoded value
Filing a SKU at a location with a quantity creates a stock record retrievable with the exact SKU, location, and quantity
The stock service raises a validation error for a negative quantity before any database write is attempted
Inserting a row with quantity = -1 directly via the real branch database raises an IntegrityError enforced by the CHECK(quantity >= 0) constraint
Inserting a stock row with sku = NULL directly via the real branch database raises an IntegrityError enforced by the NOT NULL constraint on sku
Inserting a stock row with location = NULL directly via the real branch database raises an IntegrityError enforced by the NOT NULL constraint on location
Inserting a stock row with quantity = NULL directly via the real branch database raises an IntegrityError enforced by the NOT NULL constraint on quantity
After running the Alembic migration downgrade then upgrade against the real branch database, the stock table exists with all declared columns and constraints present
Retrieving a stock record filed with an inventory_code returns that exact inventory_code unchanged
Re-filing the same SKU and location with a different quantity updates the existing record's quantity in place
After re-filing the same SKU and location, exactly one stock record exists for that pair
Inserting two rows with the same (sku, location) pair directly via the real branch database raises an IntegrityError enforced by the unique constraint
After filing the same (sku, location) pair twice against the real branch database, exactly one row exists for that pair and its quantity reflects the second filing
